scripts.title: Geth-ui dump
scripts.features:
Show everything on Gethui
(Inside coregui)
scripts.script:
if not gethui then return end

local hidden = gethui()
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "HIDDEN_UI"
folder.Parent = CoreGui

for _, ui in ipairs(hidden:GetChildren()) do
    pcall(function()
        ui.Parent = folder
    end)
end
